account_unknown: The mail account "{account}" isn't connected to this assistant any more.
search_incomplete: Couldn't load mail from every account. Check the accounts and try again.
unreachable: Couldn't reach this mailbox, even after reconnecting once. Try again later.
move_invalid: Choose a message with its mailbox and UID validity, and provide one destination.
move_same_mailbox: Choose a different mailbox for this message.
move_mailbox_missing: Couldn't find one of the mailboxes for this move.
move_message_missing: Couldn't find the message in the source mailbox. Refresh the mailbox and select it again.
move_validity_changed: The mail server reassigned the message IDs in this mailbox. Refresh the mailbox and select the message again.
move_gmail_archive: Gmail's Archive action is unavailable. You can choose another destination.
move_unsupported: This mail server doesn't support moving a single message safely.
move_failed: Couldn't move the message. Check the mailboxes and try again.
move_timeout: The mail server took too long to respond before the move started. Try again.
move_partial: The message was copied to the destination, but removal from the source could not be confirmed. Refresh both mailboxes and check where it is before trying again.
move_unknown: The mail server did not confirm whether the move was applied. Refresh both mailboxes and check where the message is before trying again.
move_summary:
Move an email in {account} from {source} to {target}
Subject: {subject}
